symptom: On Mendix 9.x and 10.0–10.8 a new constant override was refused: `alter settings constant @M.C value '…' in configuration 'Default'` → `this Mendix 9.24.30 project cannot store Settings$ConstantValue.SharedOrPrivateValue (Mendix 10.9.0+)` (14-project-settings on 9.24)
cause: settingsoverlay writes a NEW override in the nested shape (Settings$SharedValue under SharedOrPrivateValue), which is the only shape 10.9+ reads; below 10.9 the override is `{$ID, $Type, ConstantId, Value}` with a flat string. The overlay already kept an existing flat override flat, so only a new one failed
insight: **`mx convert` on the older version is a silent-data-loss detector, not just a key oracle**: given the nested form, 9.24.30 kept the override but emptied it (`Value: ""`) and still reported success — an unlowered write that got past the floor would have shipped an empty override with mx check at 0 errors. Measure the VALUE after convert, not only the key set. A private value (Settings$PrivateValue, workstation-local) has no flat form and is refused naming the constant. The reader (settings_read.go constantValueOf) already preferred the flat Value, so no reader change was needed — TestProjectSettings_Mendix9FlatConstantValue pins it. Measured: bug-test on a fresh 9.24.30 app → describe settings prints 'broker:9092', mx check 0 errors, mx convert keeps the value and changes no key in the settings unit. 14-project-settings 9.24 FAIL→PASS; 10.24.24 and 11.13 PASS. Tests: TestNormalize_ConstantValueIsFlatBelowMendix10_9, TestNormalize_RefusesAPrivateConstantValueBelowMendix10_9; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1163-constant-override-on-mendix9.mdl
